title: Spring Boot service
description: Spring Boot service (Kotlin, Maven, Paketo image) under apps/<name>.

name.description: Project name (also Maven artifactId), e.g. orders.

groupId.description: Maven groupId; the Kotlin package is <groupId>.<name without dashes>.

port.description: server.port; default: first free port from 8080 among existing spring services.

libs.description: Comma-separated kotlin-lib names this service depends on (linked via the link generator).
